title: Tangency of a fixed direction gives translation invariance
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) with R.Represents S, μ := R.measure, and v ∈ ℝ^P. Assume ∂S = 0 (BoundaryVanishes S) and p_x(v) = v for μ-a.e. x (v ∈ T_x = approxTangentPlane n M x). Then currentEval (blowUp S (−v) 1) ω = S ω for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P), i.e. S(ω(v + ·)) = S(ω).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (v : Euclid P), 0 < n → R.Represents S → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection v = v) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, currentEval (blowUp S (-v) 1 one_ne_zero) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = S ω
